title: Lucky Pigeon Brewing Co.
venue_description:
Lucky Pigeon Brewing Co.

Lucky Pigeon is a dedicated gluten-free brewery in the historic Pepperell Mill Campus in Biddeford. Guests can enjoy a rotation of regular and seasonal beers and hot dogs on gluten-free buns. The taproom is about 20 minutes from Portland and a short walk from the Saco Transportation Center.

Atmosphere and Setting

The mill campus setting gives the taproom a distinctive industrial character and the crowd is friendly and community-minded. Karaoke and trivia nights round out the schedule.

Acoustic Jam with Melissa Bragdon Caron

Starting September 22 2026 an acoustic jam hosted by Melissa Bragdon Caron runs on the second and fourth Tuesday of each month from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM. The jam is the new home of the long-running bluegrass jam previously held at Banded Brewing which is closing at the end of August 2026.

Other Programming

The taproom also hosts karaoke and trivia nights. Check its social media for the current schedule.

For Performers

Bring an acoustic instrument and an ear for bluegrass and old-time standards.

Good to Know

Lucky Pigeon is located at 40 Main St Ste 13-131 Biddeford ME 04005 with a side entrance on Laconia Street. This is a brand new jam so confirm the first date before traveling a long distance.

title: Jimmy the Greeks
venue_description:
Jimmy the Greek’s

Jimmy the Greek’s is a lively Old Orchard Beach restaurant with Greek-style cuisine and more than 50 rotating draft beers on tap billed as Maine’s largest Southern tap selection. It also houses Jimmy’s Bahhcade with bowling lanes and pool tables and arcade games.

Atmosphere and Setting

The venue markets itself as a lively restaurant with entertainment and it hosts live music and events seven days a week. Guests can watch a popular local artist play on the patio on open mic night.

Wednesday Open Mike

Every Wednesday at 6:00 PM host Paul Conner runs an open mic with a full PA provided. Performers of all ages are welcome and food and drinks are available.

Other Programming

The restaurant also hosts Local Flavah Night highlighting local breweries and other live music through the week.

For Performers

A full PA is provided so bring an instrument and a few songs.

Good to Know

Jimmy the Greek’s is located at 215 Saco Ave Old Orchard Beach ME 04064. The Athenian Room can hold up to 50 guests for private events. The open mic listing was last confirmed in August 2025 and appears on the September 2026 Maine open mic calendar.
